item.title: EA Shuts Down BioWare, Cuts 400 Jobs, Shifts Strategy
item.description: EA closes BioWare and its Edmonton studio, cuts 400 jobs, and pivots to fewer, big‑scale action‑adventure projects while reshaping its sports lineup.
